pass.certificates: Every size covered by a valid certificate

depositKindBody.CAPARRA: Kept if the buyer withdraws, paid back double if we do (c.c. art. 1385).

read.signed_out: You were signed out. Sign in again.
read.forbidden: Your role does not let you see this.
read.not_found: It does not exist, or it was removed.
read.unavailable: The factory server is not answering. Try again in a moment.
read.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
read.contract: This page and the server disagree on the data: reload the page.
read.internal: Something went wrong on the server. Try again.

write.signed_out: You were signed out: nothing was saved. Sign in again.
write.forbidden: Your role does not allow this change.
write.not_found: The quote or line no longer exists.
write.invalid: The server refused the values: check what you typed.
write.rate_limited: Too many changes at once. Wait a moment and try again.
write.unavailable: The server is not answering: not saved. Try again.
write.internal: Not saved: something went wrong on the server.
write.moved: Someone changed this quote meanwhile: it was read again. Check and repeat your change.
write.state: The quote is in a state that does not allow this now: it was read again.
write.stepUp: This needs a fresh authenticator code.

held.cannotAsk: Fix what stops the quote first (see the issues).

held.OWN_REQUEST: You asked for this approval: another approver decides.
held.NO_RIGHT: Your role does not approve quotes.
held.NEEDS_MARGIN: This request is about the margin: an approver who sees margins decides.

readOnly.noRight: Read only: your role can view quotes, not change them.
readOnly.pending: Read only while waiting for approval: withdraw the request to change it.
readOnly.approved: Approved: reopen it to change it (the approval is asked again).
readOnly.sent: Version {revision} was sent and cannot change. Make version {next} to change it.
readOnly.accepted: Accepted by the customer: it cannot change.

record.title: Quote

not_found.title: This quote does not exist
not_found.body: It may have been removed, or the address is wrong.

forbidden.title: You don't have access to this quote
forbidden.body: Quotes are for Sales, Finance and the Owner; ask an administrator for the role.

record.dockHint: Show the thread beside the tab (⌘J)
record.changed: Someone changed this quote at {time}. Your unsaved changes are kept on this page.
record.waitingYours: You asked: an approver (Finance or the Owner) decides. The lines are frozen meanwhile.
record.waitingWho: An approver decides here or from Home › Approvals; the person who asked never decides.
record.accepted: Accepted by the customer. The evidence and the deposit request are on the Documents tab.
record.noPanels: The thread and files open with the quote.

composer.title: Add a style
composer.styleHint: Type a style code or name, pick it, choose its colours: its size grid opens ready for numbers.
composer.estimate: Its cost comes from a draft revision: an estimate until the style is released.
composer.noCost: This style has no cost sheet yet: its cost and margin stay unknown.
composer.added: {style} added: type the pieces in its grid.

grid.caption: Pieces by colour and size
grid.captionOf: Pieces of {style} by colour and size
grid.notWhole: {cell}: whole pieces only, 0 to {max}. Leave the cell to put the last quantity back.
grid.cutToMax: {cell}: at most {max} pieces in one cell.
grid.pasted: Pasted {applied} values; {skipped} could not land; {clamped} brought into range.

empty.title: No lines yet
empty.body: Type a style code or name above to add the first line.

lines.certificate: Size {size}: no valid certificate covers it.
lines.removeBody_one: Its {count} line and its pieces leave this draft. You can add the style again.
lines.removeBody_other: Its {count} lines and their pieces leave this draft. You can add the style again.
lines.autosave: Saved shortly after you stop typing. A colour with no piece is not quoted.
lines.keys: Keys: n — add a style (from anywhere on this tab) · arrows, Tab, Enter — move between cells · Esc — put a cell back · ⌘V — paste a block from a spreadsheet.
lines.priceInvalid: Not a price: type a number like 450.00 (or 450,00).

summary.label: The deal at a glance
summary.title: Summary
summary.noPrice: Prices are not shown for your role.
summary.costIncomplete: Incomplete: a cost input is missing
summary.marginUnknown: Not known until every cost is known
summary.issues: What stops or concerns the quote

noPrice.title: Prices are not shown for your role
noPrice.body: A role with the price grain sees this tab.

empty.title: Add lines first
empty.body: Prices and margins appear here once the Lines tab has styles with pieces.

price.grainNote: Cost and margin columns are not shown for your role.
price.grainNoteMargin: You see margin percentages against the floor, not costs.
price.editOnLines: Prices change on the Lines tab (one place to edit).

terms.contactHint: The quote and its accept link go to this person.
terms.customerRefHint: Their request or RFQ number, printed on the quote.
terms.languageHint: The PDF and the email go out in this language.
terms.firmOfferHint: We can't withdraw it before that date (c.c. art. 1329).
terms.firmOn: Yes — it stands until the date
terms.termsNote: The standard terms of sale for the customer's kind (business, consumer, export) are printed on the PDF.
terms.promiseConsumer: Required for a consumer (Codice del Consumo art. 49).
terms.depositHint: Of the total VAT included; empty: no deposit.

consumer.title: What the law makes us say to a private buyer
consumer.grossFirst: The total VAT included is shown before acceptance (Codice del Consumo art. 49).
consumer.noWithdrawal: No right of withdrawal for a made-to-measure unit (art. 59(c)).

problem.validPast: The offer must stand at least until tomorrow.

versions.reviseNote: Version {revision} stays valid until you send version {next}. Then its link says it was replaced.

rules.title: Rule check
rules.none: No rule needs an approval. You can send it.
rules.unknown: not known yet (a cost is missing)

approval.who: Who decides: an approver (Finance or the Owner); a margin request goes to an approver who sees margins. The person who asked never decides.

docs.previewNote: Made by the server from this version, with a "sample" banner; the customer gets it without the banner when it is sent.

problem.needs: The PDF needs the invoice and delivery addresses and a validity: fill them on Terms & delivery.
problem.frozen: The sent PDF couldn't be opened. Try again, or download it from Versions.

link.title: Accept link
link.none: No link yet — it is made when you send.
link.never: The link is only in the customer's email: nobody here sees its address.

evidence.title: Acceptance evidence

emailCheck.MATCHED: The address the link was sent to
emailCheck.NOT_KNOWN: An address we did not know

evidence.differs: Does not match the stored PDF

fiscalDoc.TD02: A deposit invoice (TD02) when it is paid

ask.title: Ask for approval
ask.body: The quote breaks: {reasons}. An approver (Finance or the Owner) decides; the lines are frozen until then.

withdraw.title: Withdraw the approval request?
withdraw.body: The quote goes back to Draft and can change again. Ask again when it is ready.

approve.title: Approve quote {number}?
approve.body: You approve: {reasons}. The quote can then be sent as it is.

reject.title: Reject the request
reject.body: The quote goes back to Draft. The reason lands in the quote's history for the person who asked.
reject.hint: Required: tell them what to change.

cancel.title: Cancel quote {number}?
cancel.body: It stops here; nothing goes to the customer. Duplicate it to start again.
cancel.bodySent: The customer's accept link stops working and says the quote was withdrawn. A reason is required.

revise.title: Make version {next}?
revise.body: Version {revision} stays valid until you send version {next}. Then its link says it was replaced.
revise.noteHint: In the customer's words, printed on the new version (optional).

newLink.title: Send a new link?
newLink.body: A new accept link goes to {email} with the same PDF. The old link stops working.

reopen.title: Reopen to edit?
reopen.body: The approval no longer counts: the quote goes back to Draft and, if a rule is still broken, needs a new approval.

notice.asked: Approval asked. The lines are frozen until an approver decides.
notice.reopened: Back to Draft: the quote can change again.
notice.approved: Approved. The quote can be sent.
notice.rejected: Rejected with your reason. The quote is back in Draft.
notice.revised: Version {next} made as a draft: change it, then send it.
notice.linkFailed: The new link was made but the mail could not leave: try again.

send.title: Send quote {number} v{revision} to the customer
send.freeze: After sending, version {revision} can't change. A change makes version {next}.

can.accept: Read the quote and accept it by typing their name, or decline it.
can.deposit: See the deposit asked and how to pay it by bank transfer.
can.consumer: See the total VAT included first, and the no-withdrawal statement when it applies.

send.refused: Not sent: a check failed meanwhile. The checks were read again.

list.intro: Quotes by style, colour and size, with their price, margin, approval and the customer's answer.

bulk.exported_one: {count} quote exported (CSV, the columns you see).
bulk.exported_other: {count} quotes exported (CSV, the columns you see).
bulk.cancelHeld_one: {count} selected quote is closed already (accepted, declined, expired or cancelled): untick it.
bulk.cancelHeld_other: {count} selected quotes are closed already (accepted, declined, expired or cancelled): untick them.
bulk.cancelBody: Each stops here; nothing goes to the customer. A quote that moved meanwhile is left as it is and said.
bulk.cancelBodySent_one: {count} of them was sent: its accept link stops and says the quote was withdrawn. A reason is required.
bulk.cancelBodySent_other: {count} of them were sent: their accept links stop and say the quote was withdrawn. A reason is required.
bulk.reasonNeeded_one: Write the reason: {count} quote was sent.
bulk.reasonNeeded_other: Write the reason: {count} quotes were sent.
bulk.cancelPartly: {done} cancelled; {failed} not (changed meanwhile or not allowed): the list was read again.

empty.title: No quotes yet
empty.body: Make the first one: press c or New quote.
empty.bodyView: Quotes your colleagues make appear here.

list.noMarginNote: Margin columns are not shown for your role.

newQuote.title: New quote
newQuote.customerHint: Name, code, VAT number or tax code.
newQuote.warnings_one: The customer has {count} warning: see their record.
newQuote.warnings_other: The customer has {count} warnings: see their record.
newQuote.contactHint: The orders contact is picked when there is one.
newQuote.number: It will get number {number} (unless another quote takes it first).
newQuote.numberUnknown: The number is given when the quote is made.

held.party: This customer is {status}: no quote can go to them.
held.identity: This customer has no tax identity in force: add it to the customer first.
